acquisition_method.evidence: Targeted PRM-LC-MS analysis of selected peptides/proteins

In a first step, parallel reaction monitoring (PRM) assays were generated from a mixture containing 500 fmol of each heavy reference peptide and shotgun data-dependent acquisition (DDA) LC-MS/MS analysis on a Q-Exactive HF platform.
